reading: 1 of six independently drawn R = 12 candidate libraries passed the frozen G35-B arm-(i) recovery gate and 5 failed it, on byte-identical targets. On this target panel the gate verdict depended on which candidate library was drawn. This is a direct observation, not a statistical inference. Four-dimensional recovery under this gate is therefore not shown to be a property of the level R = 12 on this panel. The observed count is 1 of six. The library pass probability on this panel remains unknown. Failing libraries and their failed predicates: L1: P5 (beta=19/20, inoculation_day_offset=15/20, symptomatic_detection_probability=14/20, asymptomatic_detection_probability=18/20), P6 (11/20 joint hits); L2: P5 (beta=19/20, inoculation_day_offset=13/20, symptomatic_detection_probability=18/20, asymptomatic_detection_probability=15/20), P8 (beta=0/20, inoculation_day_offset=5/20, symptomatic_detection_probability=2/20, asymptomatic_detection_probability=1/20); L3: P5 (beta=18/20, inoculation_day_offset=14/20, symptomatic_detection_probability=17/20, asymptomatic_detection_probability=17/20); L4: P5 (beta=15/20, inoculation_day_offset=13/20, symptomatic_detection_probability=13/20, asymptomatic_detection_probability=13/20), P6 (10/20 joint hits), P8 (beta=0/20, inoculation_day_offset=5/20, symptomatic_detection_probability=1/20, asymptomatic_detection_probability=0/20); L6: P5 (beta=19/20, inoculation_day_offset=15/20, symptomatic_detection_probability=14/20, asymptomatic_detection_probability=18/20), P6 (11/20 joint hits), P8 (beta=0/20, inoculation_day_offset=5/20, symptomatic_detection_probability=1/20, asymptomatic_detection_probability=0/20).
